title: calamintha calamintha
intro: Calamintha calamintha, commonly known as lesser calamint, is a perennial herb native to the Mediterranean region. This plant is known for its health benefits, particularly in soothing digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and alleviating stress. The therapeutic actions of lesser calamint include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, making it useful in treating a range of ailments from skin irritations to respiratory issues. Lesser calamint is rich in bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
